lead.t:
Like disulfiram (Antabuse®),
nitroimidazoles inhibit aldehyde dehydrogenase, leading to an
unpleasant reaction due to acetaldehyde accumulation when
alcohol is consumed
Advice Patients should be warned about the reaction to alcohol
